preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Catowice residents n is between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of friendship pairs m is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each resident and cat are numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of some resident and some cat is listed at most once.
preconditions.description: No duplicate friendship pairs are given.

preconditions.expression: For every i there exists a pair between i-th resident and i-th cat.
preconditions.description: Each resident is acquainted with their own cat.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is at most 10^6.
preconditions.description: The total number of residents across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of m over all test cases is at most 10^6.
preconditions.description: The total number of friendship pairs across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: Output is either 'Yes' or 'No' for each test case.
postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether it's possible to select the jury and contestants.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then print two integers j and p where j + p = n.
postconditions.description: The number of jury members and contestants must sum to n.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then print j distinct integers from 1 to n for the jury.
postconditions.description: The indices of the residents forming the jury must be distinct and within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then print p distinct integers from 1 to n for the contestants.
postconditions.description: The indices of the cats participating as contestants must be distinct and within the range 1 to n.

invariants.expression: Each resident is acquainted with exactly one cat.
invariants.description: Each resident has a unique cat associated with them.

invariants.expression: No resident is acquainted with more than one cat.
invariants.description: There are no multiple associations within the set of residents and cats.

invariants.expression: Each cat is acquainted with exactly one resident.
invariants.description: Each cat has a unique resident associated with them.

invariants.expression: No cat is acquainted with more than one resident.
invariants.description: There are no multiple associations within the set of cats and residents.
